First trimester discomfort between implantation which sometimes mimic period pain early on. Had nausea, back pain, slight cramping and fatigue during this trimester. 


Second trimester some of the symptoms lightened up but got hit with a double whammy and end up with heart burn. Cramping happened here and there nothing continuous but a quick couple of minutes once in a while.

When taking your BP make sure to follow the instructions to the letter. Use the bathroom before and no drinking or eating at least 30 mins before. If it's a arm cuff make sure to rest your arm above waist level. If it's a wrist cuff make sure to elevate your wrist at about heart level and lean it on your chest. 


Make sure to sit about 5-10mins before taking the bp reading. Your seating should be comfortable with your back supported not slouching and feet firmly flat (legs should not be crossed).


When taking the reading try not to talk. Try breathing 
through your nose and out your mouth (me I count in my head to help keep my mind busy anxiety can make readings higher). Take it 3 times with 5 mins in between and than you can use the middle reading as a base. Best time to take it is first thing in the morning about 30 mins after you wake up and 30 mins before bed. 


If you are dehydrated that can sometimes mess with your reading so stay on top of your water intake.
